hero.title: AI-powered code review service for GitHub and GitLab pull/merge workflows.
hero.body: PR Agent automates review comments and report summaries, parses diffs with line-aware mapping, applies repository policy guardrails, and exposes operational health/metrics endpoints for production monitoring.

architecture.title: Pipeline Snapshot
ingress: NestJS controllers receive and validate webhook requests, then route to platform services.
integration: GitHub/GitLab adapters fetch diffs, parse policy, and dispatch review or command flows.
reviewEngine: Patch parser, risk scoring, structured AI output validation, and markdown rendering.

runtimeHighlights.title: Runtime Highlights
items: Deduplication and incremental review state reduce repeated AI work.
Command rate limits and webhook payload caps protect runtime stability.
Structured error JSON and metrics endpoints support incident triage.
Replay endpoints allow debug reprocessing when event-store mode is enabled.

capabilities.title: What PR Agent Handles
capabilities.subtitle: Review automation, process checks, security hints, and workflow-aware feedback.
autoReview: Runs on opened/edited/synchronize/merged events with configurable comment/report mode.
policyGuardrails: Checks issue/PR template completeness and supports remind/enforce policy mode via .pr-agent.yml.
securitySignals: Secret pattern scanning, dedupe protection, feedback learning signals, and auto-labeling.
processReview: Detects changes in workflows/templates/CODEOWNERS/CONTRIBUTING and emits process-focused feedback.

triggers.title: Automatic + Manual Triggers
prOpened: Auto review in comment or report mode, based on repository policy.
prMerged: Always emits merged summary in report mode.
commentCommands: Manual trigger through /ai-review and specialized command surface.
policyChecks: Runs pre-checks on issue and pull request events for template/process compliance.

commands.title: Interactive Command Surface
commands.subtitle: Operators can run review, ask questions, generate docs/tests, and feed back quality signals directly inside PR/MR discussions.
similarIssue: Find related issues in the same repository

mermaid.title: Runtime Topology Diagram
mermaid.subtitle: Event ingress, service dispatch, review engine, and platform API output path.

operations.title: Run, Deploy, and Monitor
operations.subtitle: Includes health checks, Prometheus metrics, replay tooling, and configurable runtime backends.
deploymentChecklist: Choose platform mode: GitHub App (recommended), plain GitHub webhook, optional GitLab webhook.
Use durable runtime state backend (sqlite recommended for production single-instance).
Configure webhook URLs and secrets, then verify /health and platform health endpoints.
Run test command flow in a real PR/MR comment thread before production rollout.
